nom: PEACH & LILY Super Reboot Resurfacing Mask

avis.titre: This is a skincare staple for me now
avis.texte: I'm on my second jar now, using this twice a week has helped my skin so much. It's softer and take up my serums and moisturizer better after use. It does sting, but with regular use it's gets easier. When I miss one or two use I know the next will sting, but by the third time of using it every 3-4 days it's easy.

avis.titre: A little tingly but i hon
avis.texte: A little tingly but i honestly look forward to when i can use it again
This is great. I wasn't sure so I got it as a free sample and fell in love. It cleared up my acne fast and made my face feel clean.

I use this peel 1x/week, and it keeps my skin refreshed, clear of acne and bumps, and ready to absorb products. If I do not use this product, or use it rarely/irregularly, there is a noticeable difference in skin health.
This is a great mask to use a few times a week. I have noticed a reduction in fine lines.

Amazing result from using it 3 times a week. Definitely a great recommendation to get. I see a big difference when using this product and my skin looks fresh, healthy, smooth and rejuvenated every time I use it and I use it consistently with my everyday routine.
I have textured, large pore, acne prone skin and this stuff smooths my texture and helps so much with my acne flare ups! My skin honestly loves this stuff.

My favorite mask. I have reordered twicE before. Not sure why this product felt less tingly on this last purchase. But I'll take it that my skin has built up some tolerance. I still feel the benefits- it leaves my skin supple, soft and decongested.

I have sensitive skin and was so nervous when I tried this because it does definitely sting while it's on but despite the stinging my skin LOVES it and it doesn't leave any lasting irritation. I use it 2x a week for 10 minutes at a time and my skin is so soft and smooth after, its been great for my skin texture. I'll definitely be repurchasing when I run out.
This mask is intense in a good way, like you can tell it's going something. And it's not too drying!

I have never used an exfoliant like this, but now I will never stop using it. After I rinse it off my skin instantly feels lighter and smoother. I use it once a week and my skin loves it. !! Try it you won't regret it.

This mask is a great weekly companion to Peach Slices Acne Exfoliating Toner. It helps to keep my skin clear without over drying, and hyperpigmentation has faded a great deal. The tingling while using it is wild but not painful. It leaves my skin feeling revitalized. I love that my skin is in such good condition I don't have to wear foundation or even concealer.
I've used this mask 2X and its already clearing the darkness I've had on my chin all my life TRY IT

I used this mask, as I have many masks, and didnt think anything about it. Next day, i looked in the mirror and thought "wow, i actually look/feel pretty today" and I kind of wondered why? What was different? And then i figured it out. I did this mask the previous day! Forgot about it… and again today, looked in mirror and thought boy, why do I look so much better today? And then…oh yeah! I did this mask this morning. Coincidence? I think not:). I LOVE this mask❤️❤️
This stuff gives a glow like you wouldn't believe! I have struggled with large/clogged pores and overall dullness my whole life and this is a double whammy savior!
the mask brings out the pimples so it did make me break out after using it but after a couple days your skin is as clear and even as ever.

avis.titre: my go to mask for a fresh start
avis.texte: I am a huge fan of this exfoliating mask, as are my early twenties daughters. It is easy to apply and leaves our skin feeling smooth and looking very bright. My skin is normal, if it is feeling on the drier side I sometimes notices a slight "picky" feeling as the mask begins to work but nothing that feels harsh or like I should wash it off immediately.

it definitely brings all of the toxins to the surface of your face, which is a good thing, but for me at least results in breaking out and uneven skin tone. I've noticed that every time after I use it, my skin appears darker, which might be a chemical burn I do for the tingle, but I can leave the mask on for the full 15 minutes and be fine. I just think that my skin reacts poorly to it if you have sensitive skin or dealing with irritation acne, I wouldn't recommend it. It just makes it worse. or if you have bad scarring, don't! it makes a scarring worse. I did this mask two days before Thanksgiving and now I'm trying to fix it the day before Thanksgiving.😩
This is the only product I own that makes a difference in my skin after just one use. I will never not have this in my skincare routine!

I really love this product,. It absorbs quickly, and hydrates my skin very well. I also feel like it helps the other procucts that I put on my skin to absorb better into my skin.Makes my skin look Great and I am really happy with it.

I love almost all P&L products, and this mask is no exception! I use once/twice a week, and it leaves my mature skin oh so soft. For my skin, I follow up with Star Overnight cream and my skin the next morning is so hydrated and glowing. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Helped me combat a sudden cystic acne breakout
avis.texte: The Super Reboot Resurfacing Mask is a product to which I have returned thanks to a sudden breakout of some severe cystic acne during my last menstrual cycle. I can't afford to splurge too often on skincare, but I remembered that when I last used this mask (several years ago), it helped control my acne quite well.This time, the cyst I had was particularly large, so recovery still took longer than average but the mask helped bring it to a head, thus expediting treatment.I'm very glad this product's effectiveness has not changed since I last used it. Thank you, Peach & Lily!
Made my face feel so soft! Love that it doesn't have any physical exfoliation as I'm not keen on that texture. Think the jar will last a long time too!
Ordered multiple times. A regular part of my skincare routine. Get told all the time I look in my early mid 20s but I'm 35! Best product ever.
Be a bit cautions when using any blemishes in skin will definitely cause it to stings a it goes away but it was a shock my first use. . however my nose has never been more clear!

First of the mini travel one is super cute!! Second, this is a well rounded mask. I really do use it when I feel like I need a lil "reboot" I also don't mind the tingling sensation, personally it has never gotten to the point where it was painful either.
I absolutely love this product! It makes my skin clearer and smoother.
Felt the nice tingly sensation while waiting but haven't seen improvements yet as it's still early
My absolute holy grail of exfoliating. I cannot go a week without this treatment!

I cannot get past the horrible smell of this product. I had to rinse it off after one minute, just smelled so bad, almost like mold. I love all of the other Peach and Lily products, kind of disappointed, I really wanted to love it.
Big fan of this product! It really cleaned my skin and left my skin glowing and radiant.

This is one of those masks where you can feel and see a difference after one use, but you can definitely feel and see the effects with continued use! For me, it stings for a few seconds after application; However, that feeling quickly goes away. I leave it on for longer than the recommended time mainly because I forget im wearing it, but have not experienced any negative side effects. A little goes a long way! The mask is a thin, gel consistency that spreads easily. I use a synthetic bristle brush to apply. It rinses off easily. My skin feels very soft after rinsing and I follow it up with the Glass Skin Refining Serum and Matcha Antioxidant Pudding. I use it once a week, and after a couple of weeks even my coworkers were complimenting me about how smooth and glowy my skin looked. I use to have discoloration around my mouth and a few acne scars on my chin and cheeks, but they're no longer visible. Texture? Gone, too. Highly recommend!

I have acne prone skin and for the last couple months my skin has really been going through it. I havent broken out this bad in a very long time and I've been looking for other masks as the ones I've been using haven't felt like they're working for me. So I decided to purchase this resurfacing mask and I am blown away; within the first week my skin looked and felt better and within a month I noticed i wasnt breaking out as much and my closed comedones were already going away. I am so glad I decided to try this mask out and definitely going to try their skin care products. I'm a forever customer now. :hands_heart_light_skin_tone:
It burns so badly, it smells even worse but does it work wonders!! Truly my skin showed a noticeable difference after the first use. It's worth every penny, I cannot recommend enough!!

avis.titre: The Best! So Fresh and Effective!
avis.texte: This mask is better than all the mask I tried! Makes my skin is so glowy, pores are refined, make fine lines disappear. I love the results! I love Peach and Lily!

I have very sensitive combined skin and was skeptical to try just bc I don't really have a face routine but I have enjoyed this product so far I do it twice a week and my skin has never felt better or looked better!
I will it does burn a bit I keep it on for 3-4 mins but if you are sunburn definitely do not use I figured that out haha. But it does an amazing job I freaking love it!!

Product does tingle a little at first when you put it on then it goes away. For the people who experienced burns, this isnt a product you can just use if you dont have a consistent skincare routine already. You have to have a strong skin barriee for this product for sure. I loved it. I've been having some annoying texture and decided to try it out, immediately after taking it off even some of the new breakouts/bumps I have got smaller. More surface level with the skin so it definitely does what it advertises for sure! Love it.

I do enjoy this resurfacing serum and I think it works - I can feel the difference in my skin. I try to use it the two times a week at most but I haven't been as consistent with it but not a fault of the serum.
There is a little bit of burning when first applied but afterwards my skin feels much smoother. I use about once a week or every two weeks
I love the feel it gives. It actually works! I am proud of myself for purchasing it

It stings my face upon application but it dried and it doesn't sting anymore. It does work! My face is softer than it's ever been after I use this and I feel like I have new skin. Also there's a lot in this jar, like I barely have to use any and a super thin layer completely covers my face. It definitely works.
This exfoliant is great for sensitive skin. Even after multiple uses, this exfoliant does not cause irritation or breakouts.

This is THE BEST AHA/BHA mask out there and it truly works! It tingles at first which is normal but with weekly usage you'll see skin looks brighter, dark spots fade and literally peel off, and it's just amazing. Please never stop making this powerhouse. 🙏:skin-tone-3:
I use once a week, my skin is so soft and smooth. Definitely notice a positive difference in texture.
Love using this mask weekly. It makes your skin smooth after.

No other product I have ever used for anything delivered results as well as this mask does. I hate the texture, it smells awful, and it aggressively stings putting it on, but it leaves my face so smooth and refreshed. I will be restocking this when I run out.
This mask does the trick I. 10-15 minutes. I kept it on longer some days. When I remove the mask, my skin has a beautiful glow with no makeup.

avis.titre: Possibly the only thing that has helped my hyperpigmentation
avis.texte: I don't know what it is with my skin, but every time I get so much as a little pimple, it leaves behind a dark mark that sicks around FOREVER. Seriously, my dark spots are the worst. I'm only a month in with this mask, and already I can see a noticeable difference. No other product has ever done that for me.

I've seen some good benefits from this product. I have uneven skin and I've used this about four times and can already feel the smoothness. The tingling feeling is minimal and only until it dries. I try to use this at least once a week if not twice in my skincare routine. I use it right after I do the cleanser. The consistency is like a smooth jelly and a little goes a long ways.

Got the travel size first to try it, and I'll definitely buy the full size later ! This mask isn't too harsh on the skin and it's really effective. My skin feels so soft, poreless and rejuvenated after using it !
The best exfoliator and mask, I use this weekly for a complete detox and the travel size is perfect when on the go.

I initially tried a free sample with my initial P&L purchase. First use had some mild tingling and I felt my skin had become soft to the touch. Since then I've bought the full sized product and used it once a week as a refresh as I wear makeup. I feel like my skin looks revitalized once again and brighter as well as softer. A little goes a long way too.
Love this product so much and have used it for years. It just works. It leaves my skin so smooth and minimizes my pores.
After using this, my face feels so rehydrate and it helps with removing blackhead.
My skin just glows after I use it and is sooooo smooth. I love how it refines my skin snd minimizes my pores. It definitely mskes me look younger! Highly recommend!
Yes the product stings a bit BUT it leaves your skin so glowy and glass skin!! I love it! Remember to mosturize a lot after using the product.

Without a doubt the greatest skincare mask I've ever tried—it's the same consistency as when in first bought it in 2021 and it's the same radiating, skin-smooth glow I have the next day. Truly, my holy grail mask.
This product totally changed my skin. I only left the mask on for 5 minutes, but what a difference!
I use this once a week and it makes my face so smooth and soft!

If you have to oick one item to splurge on, let it be this. It will change the look ans feel of your skin in the furst treatment and it just gets better weekly. First couple uses there is very minor tingle but after that its gone. Your makeup will apply amazing as the surface of your skin smooths out. BUY IT

I have used this product once a week for years. I love the smell of it, and how it exfoliates my sensitive skin. I seriously cannot use any other product to exfoliate without burning, itching, and redness. This product tingles for the first minute, but then cools and leaves my skin smooth and glowy. I hope its always available, because I don't know what I would do without it!!
This mask is my go-to! Leaves my skin clear and hydrated. Consistency is great. I received as a sample and loved it so much I ordered a larger size.

avis.titre: What acid must feel like on skin
avis.texte: Worst face mask ive used by far! It was recommended by a girl working at ulta. I was looking for a product to help with texture. Told her i was currently using peter roth pumpkin mask. She said "no go with peach and lily, its Korean and Korean's are big in regulating what they out in their products. Its actually what im using rn." Youd think she'd mention how awful it burns if she was actually using it. Im now positive she was in fact not usung this mask but was just pushing it because of the korean skin care fad. Anyway, it burns on the skin like crazy. No its not a slight tingling sensation, it BURNS. I thought maybe after a few uses my skin would get used to it but the burning never went away. And i never noticed any change on the texture of my skin or change in breakouts.

BEST face mask i've ever used, clears up my acne/acne scars every time that i use it. i was a bit reluctant to buy this due it being a bit more on the expensive side but it's totally worth it!!! will be buying again and again and again
I love this for exfoliating. The tingle feeling means it's working
The texture takes some getting used to but otherwise it's a great product.
Love it. Not heavy. Feels soothing when it is on. Skin feels amazing.

I love this chemical peel/mask. It has light/no scent, the color is beautiful and it is gentle, but effective. It exfoliates without drying out or irritating the skin. I first received this as a sample and HAD to buy the full size. I use this one to two times a week, depending on my skin/what I've been doing. Such an easy way to "reboot" your skin and wake up to fresh, clear, smooth, glowy skin.
Great to apply at least once a week as part of your skincare routine.

I was skeptical about this product and prestige skin care in general. I received this as a freebie and was informed about the tingle that might happen when I used it. I am dark skinned, and have a lot of acne scars from neglecting my skin care because of recent depression. The freebie I received is smaller than this, but once I was almost finished with the product, my skin was noticeably more clear. I will be purchasing the full size! Anyone with dark spots no matter what skin color needs this! Just be aware of the scent, which I actually like, and be aware of the tingle. If it burns too much, of course take it off. Peach and lily did their thing with this one! ONG!

The mask tingles at first but after a couple uses you start to get use to it. Ive noticed that the exfoliating has removed a couple bumps that were on my forehead, and the fine lines around my eyes are slowly disappearing thanks to this My skin is wayyy lighter and it got rid of so many tiny bumps around my face that's been there for years so I would 100 percent recommend even my mom loves this

Love this mask. I love the light Melony smell and the slight tingle you get on applying. It's hydrating and clears you skin. My only recommendation is not to use more than needed as dryness can occur.
This stuff is crazy! It tingles a bit, but man when you rinse it off your skin is glistening like never before!
This mask is a game changer. Leaves skin feeling exfoliated and softer. I'm using with the entire glass skin line and the texture and tone of my skin has improved drastically.
Have been using this for several years now and turned a few friends on to this product because it genuinely works for aging skin. The stinging sensation subsides after consistent use.

avis.titre: Dupe for a Diamond Glow Facial
avis.texte: I'm so glad I discovered another amazing product from Peach & Lily. I have found this to be a great alternative for achieving results similar to a diamond glow facial treatment. Just stay consistent in your usage each week to reap the benefits!

avis.titre: Absolutely love this! Except no warning.
avis.texte: I love this so far, I've used it for about 2 weeks and already notice less acne scars. However, I give it four stars due to no warning on the potency. You can seriously hurt yourself if you don't use a very small amount. If it burns, stop! Apply less
This has become a huge staple in my routine. My skin instantly looks brighter after removing the mask.
Love at first try back in 2019 and sonce then I've never been without it, youll get used to the initial stingy feeling but it goes away pretty fast. Results are the chef's kiss of exfoliating masks!

This is a mask I wouldn't use more than twice a week, it's a little strong/harsh on the skin. And definitely moisturize after you wash it off. But it does help clear up my skin and I will be using this in moderation going forward.
I love this mask. This is my second time buying it. A little goes a long way.

I absolutely love this face mask! I'm 64 years old and use it about once a week. My skin just glows after I use it and is sooooo smooth. I love how it refines my skin snd minimizes my pores. It definitely mskes me look younger! Highly recommend!

I have a lot of dark spots and acne scars from my youth and even today on my chin. Every time I use this I look in the mirror and feel like my scars are fading better and better. I follow the instructions exactly and use it on Mondays and Thursdays.

I'm 73yrs old w/dry skin. I've been taking care of my skin in only the past 10 yrs but I've tried a lot. I use Retinol A but everything else is P&L. I finally tried Super Reboot mask & I'm blown away. This was my 1st time. Kept on for 29 minutes f/b copper serum & peptide moisturizer & results were amazing!! I still have wrinkles but my skin is glowing, retexturized & even my pores much less noticeable. Honestly don't hesitate. I've never, ever tried anything this rewarding. P. S. stay away from eye area.
This product sure does wonders and truly clears out the pores! Definitely worth buying again!

Effective product to have in rotation. Exfoliates well and though it is drying it does not feel overly harsh or irritating. I would buy this again. Good for when skin has been congested or needs a reset.

My skin always feels so smooth after I use this mask. I do experience some tingling, but nothing that causes irritation. I only use a little bit each time I use it (1x/week at most), so the jar goes a long way. I can't say whether my skin has drastically changed, but when I want to use a chemical exfoliator, this is an option I'll come back to.
I have combined this with the glass skin refining serum and have noticed great improvement on my skin. Im in my late 30s and trying to slow down the clock.
After using the mask, my skin feels so soft and looks so refreshed! I like the slight tingly feel.
I love what this product does. It makes my skin look fresh and I love doing this routine for myself
I love this mask, my skin always feels clearer and brighter afterward. I've bought this many times now and will continue to do so

I've been using this mask for my sensitive combination (oily, normal), dehydrated (not dry), hormonal acne-prone skin. My last jar ran out a few months ago, and I hadn't repurchased. I definitely noticed a difference. I've had it again for about 10 days now, and it's just the best. Moisturized, unclogged, radiant skin! I do feel a little stinging/tingling in the beginning, but even when I used it for 20 minutes, I had no irritation.
Will definetly make your skin texture 10x better. Felt clean and hydrated

This mask is powerful, I felt an immediate difference. I've used it twice now and I can see and feel the difference on my skin. It's pretty strong, so I think I'll use it once every other week because my skin is sensitive. Love it.

avis.titre: Makes my skin so soft and smooth
avis.texte: I am older (60+) and love this AHA/BHA mask. The first time I used it, I left it on for about 15 minutes and had no burning and very little tingling. After washing it off and using my usual serum and moisturizer, my skin felt as soft and smooth as a baby's bum. I did find that I needed a little more moisturizer than usual after using this, but that's OK, and while I also wish the mask was thicker and not so liquid, it's fine. The results are fantastic.

avis.titre: Left my skin soft and smooth
avis.texte: I got this as a sample so haven't been using for a long time, but after one use my skin feels fresh and clean and my wrinkles appear less visible. I will order in the future!
Gorgeous! Totally removed the rough texture to my skin as winter descends.

This is not a good mask. Considering that you can leave it on for up to 20 minutes, I think I lasted less than 2. I have gotten chemical peels from a dermatologist which are typically stronger and have never had an irritation or burn like this mask gave me. Only my neck was affected immediately, but I can't imagine what would've happened had I left it on for the 15-20. I think the Peter Thomas Roth Pumpkin Enzyme mask is a much better product, and it does NOT burn or irritate like this one at all. I don't typically have sensitive skin except for maybe my neck on occasion, but like I said, the PTR never bothered me even if my skin was in a sensitive state.
I love this mask. I see an immediate difference in my skin texture and it drastically reduced the redness from acne with one use.

I did not like this product. Mild burning was not the case for me. It started burning immediately and I tried to wait 10 minutes but was so ready to wash off immediately. I lasted 5 min. My face was irritated for days afterwards. My daughter and husband used it and they tolerated it well. Just didn't work for me. I would like to try other products but not this anymore.

avis.titre: Powerful Resurfacing Mask for Smoother Skin
avis.texte: I absolutely love this resurfacing mask! It leaves my skin feeling instantly smoother after each use. It has a noticeable tingling sensation, so I've learned to be careful and avoid the eye area entirely. Given how strong it is, I'd recommend starting with just once or twice a week to see how your skin reacts. When I overuse it, I do notice it can lead to some whiteheads, so using it sparingly really helps balance the results. Overall, it's a fantastic addition to my skincare routine for a fresh, smooth complexion, but definitely requires a bit of caution.

avis.titre: Once a Week Nighttime Addition to Routine
avis.texte: I have been using this once a week for the past three weeks now. The texture is more liquid-y than other masks, so be prepared for it to try and slip out of your hands! When I apply it, there is an initial tingling/tightening/prickly feeling (as the packaging advertised). I haven't left it on longer than five minutes at a time because I use it in the evening after washing my face and I'm usually ready to go to bed at that point, but I have found my face to feel very smooth and soft right after washing it off.

I first tried this product as a sample. I liked it but since I only tried once I wasn't sure if the results could've been attributed to other products and I was curious. So I bought it and have been using it twice a week. This product is awesome. 10/10 will make sure I always have it in my routine. I

Made my face break out like crazy. I figured it was just the initial clearing process but tried it 2 more times and got the same result. The breakouts were not just regular pimples either they were deeper and harder that lasted a few weeks. Not a fan!
I really liked using this mask. After using it just once I could notice a difference in my skin. This mask is good at getting blackheads that have been sitting on your face a while.

Best exfoliating product I've ever used. I have very dry & sensitive skin. This is so gentle but works so well. I don't put it on my cheeks (because I have rosacea) but I apply it to my forehead, nose, and chin and when I wash it off, my skin feels silky and hydrated. My forehead looks so smooth and my wrinkles are less noticeable.

Just like the glass skin serum,an oldie but goodie. Something I will continue to buy over and over again because it gives you a makeshift gentle chemical peel without the price tag! As with all of their products,a little goes a long way and it makes such a difference getting rid of clogged pores. Gets rid of overall texture and brings a youthfulness to your face even after one use. Would recommend to anyone,regardless of skin type
Wow. You can see changes from the first use. Amazing mask, one of the best I've used, worth every dollar! highly recommend!
Gentle enough on my sensitive rosacea skin. I'd use no more than once a week

I like skincare products with unusual ingredients as most other products have a traditional set. This mask has blue agave and I often make masks of agave fruit from our garden. It's so pleasant for my combination skin, I feel a flood of different nutrients my face is absorbing and feels clean, fresh and breathing. I also feel the same effect from this mask

This is the second time I've purchased this mask. It's so refreshing and it leaves my skin feeling so smooth. The consistency is lovely and I appreciate that I don't have to use very much each time. I also have very sensitive skin and this is very gentle.

I love this mask! The ingredients in this cool gel gives my face a nice weekly reboot (great name for the product). The cooling feel as it sets on my face is a nice refreshing yet relaxing feel and is a great addition to my weekly skincare routine. I workout every morning, and I want my skin clean before I start without doing my 12 step skincare routine and then sweating it off. So I created my own "wake up routine" that i do before my workout and then after my workout I do my "regular" morning skincare routine. This veil mist is part of my wake up combo routine that I spritz on my face and neck after I cleanse with the Face Polisher. It's the perfect start to my day and I feel clean and fresh when I start my workout. I'm noticing a significant change in my 54 year old face and am loving my personalized 12 step skincare routine recommended to me by Peach & Lily personally through email. I love this company and their products!
I love it ! It's like doing myself a facial at home :house_with_garden: perfect I'm a huge peach and lily fan.
Using this has made my fine lines and pores around my nose reduce so much!!
I love this brand and was looking for another exfoliator. Seems to work well, tingling as stated is not too bad. I think since I only use about once per week it's hard to say how well it's working
I love this brand but this mask is not it. The label says "mild tingling is normal", but this mask BURNS on my skin. Can't stand to leave it on for more than 15 seconds.
Got as a sample and could tell immediately that the results were going to be fantastic. My pores were visibly smaller within 15 minutes. Will be purchasing NOW!
I like an active mask that feels like its working. This does the trick! Its does tingle or sting a little but it only lasts for a few minutes. Leaves skin feeling refreshed and smoother.

avis.titre: Been Facing My Chicken Pox Scars!!!
avis.texte: The super reboot mask has been doing an excellent job at fading.My chickenpok scars period I was really worried about them because I am dark skinned (medium-dark skin color, Black woman) So hyperpigmentation will be more prominent and dark if it appears on my skin period but today my sister even commented that my chicken pox scars were fading significantly. I used this mask in conjunction with some other skin care products (Mother Science). But I'm happy with the result. Too bad it's not a body wash, then I could use it on the other chicken pox cars left on my body.

For the price you cannot beat this mask. I feel it is potent and doing its job when I feel the little tingle but it only lasts for a short time so it is not uncomfortable. I use it twice a week to ensure I get all those dead skin cells off.

My absolute favorite. I love buying new products and trying new things. But I keep buying this product. It makes your pores go bye bye. It tingles but is not drying. Its magic. I love it. Buy it. A little goes a long way. I repurchase every 6 ish months.

I get congested spots where my glasses sit and also have hyperpigmentation that has been fading with once-weekly use. It's a little pricy but I think it's a good alternative to another AHA/BHA mask available. Minimal stinging and you only need a little.

I bought this mask from ulta for my birthday strictly because of the reviews. I haven't had any good experiences with face masks simply because I give up on them before I can see any results. I am a medium skin tone, I have larger pores specifically in my T-zone, textured skin, and oily/combination skin. When I tried it the first time I just thought ok, this is good but let's see how long this lasts. I started using it about 3 weeks ago once a week, now on my 3rd week I've increased it to twice a week. I have noticed a huge difference since using this mask.My skin has never felt so healthy, mind you this is with me eating like a cow since it's been my husband and I's birthday month, what diet lol? I even was surprised that my skin even looks amazing pre and post period, I've noticed I feel "uglier" post period and lately I've been feeling my best.

bought it half off to try and im so glad i did! im in my mid 20s and struggle with fine lines, but after my first time using this I noticed that they were completely gone from my forehead area!!! its so nice that it just instantly got rid of one of my biggest insecurities! i think this jar will last a long time, as a little goes a long way but i'll definitely repurchased! it left my skin smoothed but definitely a bit parched for hydration- id recommend using this right befofe bed then applying a thick nighttime lotion :)
So far I like it! I'm using it 1-2 times per week and it hasn't broken me out or caused any issues. My skin is always so glassy after using this mask.
This mask feels fabulous. I put it in the refrigerator to get a cool refreshing experience in the summer. It makes my skin feel and look so soft and supple.

I am 27 and have been fighting hormonal acne since my young teens. With Peach and Lily I have finally been able to see results even with my sensitive skin. Because of thr continuous acne I have dark spots and scars and was looking for something to try but was hesitant due to my sensitive skin. I love the rest if the line so i tried this resurfacing mask after reading some reviews and it did not disappoint. I left it on dor 20 minutes as instructed and it did cause some tingling; but with AHA i was not surprised. I saw my mom the next day and she noticed a change right away and made a comment about how bright my skin looked! I have used it 2 more times since and continue to notice a difference! I will be repurchasing!
This feels so good when applying and my skin feels soft and smooth after. Glycolic acid is the 2nd ingredient on this fabulous mask. Try it and love it!
I love this mask, ny face feels very soft and smooth but I have noticed it doesn't tingle but burns the first few minutes I apply it. nothing a fan and cold air can't help but fair warning!

avis.titre: Can't believe I didn't have this sooner!
avis.texte: I just added this to my skincare regimen 1x/week. The both times I've used this, my skin feels so smooth afterwards! I was shocked! I love this mask!

I am deep into my post menopause years. And my skin has changed drastically. I used to have oily skin with large pores, and would break out easily. Now I have dry skin... and I still breakout. The first time I used it i was shocked. Only for 10 minutes and I felt like it took years off of my face. Love this product. My skin is so soft and shiny. It looks new.

It was very messy. It did nothing for me. I used it a few times. I don't understand why it didn't work for me. I'm glad it worked for other people, but it didn't work for me. I didn't burn or anything.
Have only used twice so far (once a week). Can definitely tell the product is working the skin with the mild tingling. Am obsessed with the silky smooth feeling once it's washed off.

My teenaged daughter gets blackheads on her nose and thick, dead skin clings to her nose as well. Used 1-2 times per week on the entire area completely clears up the blackheads and gets rid of the dead skin build-up. I mean COMPLETELY! She complains that it stings a little but no redness or irritation is evident after washing it off. She uses a thin layer and lets it do its magic for 5-15 minutes depending on her mood lol. Its pricey but a little goes a long way, especially used just on blackhead-prone areas. Absolutely worth every penny to get her skin back to smooth as a baby's.
Always loved this product. Really smoothes the fine lines and evens the tone of my skin.
This mask is an absolute must! I do this mask every Sunday night and it leaves my skin so soft and smooth. Absolutely love it
I was using a different face mask before this. It was harsh and burned. This mask is wonderful. Has a slight tingling sensation but nothing worrisome. Washing off easily also. I really enjoy it.

This exfoliant does a great job exfoliating and striping your skin. I gave it a 4 because my skin is a little sensitive and can only handle it about once a week.

avis.titre: Deep cleansing mask safe for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Deep cleansing. A bit of a sting at first but very quickly calms. Does everything it claims to do, as was safe for my very sensitive skin.
I absolutely love this product! It leaves my skin glowy and my pores smaller!

I've loved every product from P&L and this mask is no exception. I have very sensitive skin that's prone to redness and dryness but this exfoliates my skin and leaves it smooth, even, calm, and minimizes my pores. Following up with the glass skin routine, my skin has never been happier. One of my fav products that will hopefully be a forever staple
This is the best mask ever! Leaves skin soft and clears up zits
Great mask, I've been using it once a week and so far, so good!

This acid exfoliant has been such a game changer for me. I used to use very harsh and abrasive mechanical exfoliants, and my skin would get irritated or wouldn't feel as clean and healthy as I hoped it would. The Super Reboot Resurfacing Mask makes my face feel like butter after use, and it's kept my skin so clean. Whenever I notice that my skin looks dull or starts to break out, I use this exfoliant on a schedule (usually every three to four days for a week or two) and it dramatically changes the look and texture of my skin. I do notice a mildly irritating sting after not using it for a while or when experiencing many breakouts, but it only lasts for a few minutes and doesn't persist at all after I wash the mask off. Overall, this exfoliant mask is an absolute favorite product and I like to have it in stock at all times.

avis.titre: A great addition to my routine!
avis.texte: It does tingle after applying but goes away after a bit. My skin looks and feels smoother and more calm. Adding this into my normal Peach & Lily skincare routine has made a noticeable difference.

I have a lot of trouble with dryness, texture, and clogged pores. I use this at least once a week, which definitely helps. It works way better when I remember to use it every other or every third day. I have very sensitive skin, but this doesn't irritate or make my skin red. Just a little tingly when I first put it on.

My skin is combination sensitive with a pretty bad barrier. I was hesitant with this mask but have loved all the other Peach and Lily products I've used. I bought the travel size and once a week apply for 15 minutes. Online recommends 15 to 20 minutes while the jar recommends 5-20 minutes. Once you've applied it dries to a very shiny thin layer on your skin and is almost not noticeable unlike many masks on the market.

I will be honest, I was expecting that my sensitive skin would be very upset with this stuff so I only bought the travel size to try. I was actually surprised when it didn't make my skin burn and turn red and not a blister was to be found. AND that stubborn, painful "time of the month" acne is under control again. So yay. I am very happy.

Ive been using this mask for the last two months and the results have been great. The mask tingles at first but after a couple uses you start to get use to it. Ive noticed that the exfoliating has removed a couple bumps that were on my forehead, and the fine lines around my eyes are slowly disappearing thanks to this treatment. If you're able to get a sample of this product I would definitely recommend buying it.

This is a forever staple. A little goes a very long way, I usually only have to dip my silicone applicator a few times without scooping the product. There's a tingly sensation to it but it's nothing that's unbearable. I usually let it sit for 15 out of the 5-20 minutes recommended time and after I remove it my face is left feeling soft and renewed to where I can't stop touching my face but this is definitely a weekly treatment for me!

Made my sensitive skin turn red. FYI, I tried to contact Peach and Lily numerous times. Your email did not work, and I sent a text per your instructions. My Help message never responded to, so I had to pay for a product that was harmful to my skin. Never again..

My skin always looks more refreshed after using this mask. I attribute this to the gentle removal of the dead cells on the surface. I love this mask and have repurchased it a few times already. Forewarning, it can feel very spicy/itchy if you have more dead cells to remove. I don't have sensitive skin, but I imagine if you do, just leave it on for a lesser amount of time.
I love this resurfacing mask, I can feel it going deep into my skin. I have acne prone skin and I use this once a week to get all of the dead skin off my face

That being said the stinging goes away after a minute or two and I keep it on for about 20min. I definitely metodę my skin being clearer and smoother since I started using it, and I get even less breakouts. I'll be buying it again.

avis.titre: I've experienced no redness or irritation while using this p

I have very sensitive skin, so I'm happy to report that this product has performed extremely well for me. I receive all the exfoliation benefits, but without any irritation or redness of the skin afterwards. I'm also sensitive to fragrances, whether artificially or naturally derived, and this product has never been an issue in that regard either.

I've had this product for about a month now, using it about twice a week. I love how soft and smooth my face feels after, and my mood picks up after using it because it feels like an affirmation of self-care/love to me. The only downside is the stinging burn due to my acne. Some nights I'm able to tolerate it for the recommended time, and others I have to shave off time. But overall, I think it's a great experience! I don't know if I'd make a second purchase until I completely finish up the one I have as it feels too early to make that decision.

I received a sample size of this product and loved it so much I purchased the full size! I absolutely love this product and would recommend to my friends. I do this mask every Sunday right before I go to bed and it is so relaxing! I was nervous at first when it said that your face will feel a tingle, but my face feels so good afterwards especially when I pair it with my ice roller.
This is something that will always be in my skin care routine. I use this once a week. I have roseca and very sensitive skin, and this is wonderful.
I bought this on a whim. I absolutely love this. This is like my treat at the end of a day. Easy to put on easy to wash off.. some tingling when you first put it on but nothing crazy. its so good!
